primary_baseline.variant: ViT-B/32, official Google checkpoint converted in Transformers
primary_baseline.query_mode: One support image crop, image-guided detection, no text query
primary_baseline.score: Maximum sigmoid of raw image-guided detector logits; not per-image normalized display scores
primary_baseline.localization: Highest-score box, common image-bound clipping, IoU>=0.5 against any noncrowd target box
primary_baseline.training_difference: OWL uses borrowed large-scale pretrained weights. HyperNet uses only its own synthetic training. Both receive the same one boxed natural support per target and the same query pixels.
primary_baseline.exposure_limit: The official checkpoint card names COCO/OpenImages fine-tuning. New COCO photos are fresh to HyperNet iterations, not established unseen by OWL.
primary_baseline.metric_limit: Macro top-one localized recall at a fixed DEV false-positive budget is not standard published COCO AP, and these results do not compare every Google OWL model.

sources.supports: Model identity, CLIP pretraining and detection fine-tuning, COCO/OpenImages training exposure
Image-guided object detection with one exemplar, distinct from text-prompt detection
Official image_guided_detection API and detector outputs
OWLv2 also supports image-guided detection; a separate model family, not the current primary checkpoint
OWLv2/OWL-ST research, scaling open-vocabulary detection; background rather than a measured comparator here

reference_annotation_disclosure: One supplied bounding-box crop per category is used by every method. The 288 old DEV photos and labels additionally calibrate global thresholds; they are not counted as natural-image weight training, but they are real supervision.
